reports.authoredInput: Original synthetic two-operator register programs. YM3526 OPL1 has one sine waveform; OPL2 waveform selection writes are verified to leave PCM unchanged.
reports.frameCountScope: Both builds: main complete body renders plus explicit257-frame post-scenario probes, including selected public reset/replays. Bounded wrapper positives and actual VgmPlayer Engine render-ahead/seek-prefix frames are separate components of totalGeneratedOutputStereoFrames. Engine internal native source frames and player delivered frames are not added twice.
limits: Native PCM runs at floor(clock/72). The OPL1 core supplies one mono output copied to both sides. Engine cases test averaging/holding at separate output rates, without optional Sega PSG.

No raw save/load exports or public state API exist for this wrapper/Engine. Internal state bytes are not inspected or claimed equivalent; continuation PCM probes, public reset/replay and VgmPlayer seek replay are compared instead.

Raw reset preserves existing free-running counters and pending address; public reset recreates the native handle and reapplies the JS mute mask. Both existing paths are exercised without changing them.

Status includes fixed0x06, TimerA0x40/TimerB0x20 and IRQ0x80. Even bus reads alias status; odd reads return0xff. Positive timer masks/clear/stop/CSM tests supplement real hooks compared at synchronous chunk boundaries.
VgmPlayer seeks use the existing replay-from-zero helper. Actual rendered Engine frames include prefetch queues and are counted separately from delivered/discarded player frames.
No browser, Worklet scheduling, Native backend, physical hardware, Mixer or listening judgement is tested.

record.reviewScope: Independent read-only review of final YM3526 OPL1 checker,14 input/report hashes and arithmetic main/self/player counter reconstruction. No production or checker source edits by reviewer.

playerFrameDerivation.method: Twice full7168-sample baseline; each seek prefix plus257 continuation consumes authored waits through the next event boundary. Sum rates over3clocks×2builds; delivered seek-discarded frames are not added twice.

reviewedInvariants: YM3526 OPL1 is distinguished from OPL2: six waveform-register selections produce identical sine PCM. No new OPL2 waveform or state API is introduced.

All9melody channels,2connections×8feedback settings,5distinct drums, all rhythm masks and AM/PM/depth/envelope changes are programmed. Positive FM/additive,feedback,AM/PM and EGT comparisons produce changed PCM.
Timer A first IRQ frame4 and B16; flags0x40/0x20 and fixed0x06 remain visible; masks hide flags/IRQ without stopping timer. Unmask reveals expired flag. Stop plus clear remains cleared after64frames.
Masked TimerA CSM produces audible PCM on each of9isolated channels without normal key-on; status/IRQ remains masked.
Drum physical groups6=bass,7=snare+hiHat,8=tom+cymbal; melody/rhythm unmute matches uninterrupted synthesis progression.
Pending address survives generation and raw reset. Raw reset retains free-running phase; public reset recreates power-on waveform and reapplies JS mute.
Real read/write/IRQ hooks compared at synchronous boundaries; even reads alias status and odd reads return0xff. Internal serialized state is not claimed equivalent.
Owned PCM starts audible, survives same-buffer overwrite and capacity+1 growth. Engine average/hold source counts/remainder and single master gain checked.
Actual VgmPlayer runs9clock/rate routes×6seek positions with no checkpoints. Reset/replay-from-zero continuation matches baseline exactly.
Main bodies/probes, bounded positives and actual VgmPlayer Engine prefetch generation are separate. All frame counters independently recompute.
limits: Exact agreement validates these fixed builds, not original hardware accuracy.
No snapshot state serialization or portability is claimed; exported wrapper lacks that API.
OPL2, OPL3, optional PSG mixing and physical device scheduling are excluded from this checker.
Separate browser4route and narrowed OPL1 UI checks cover browser integration; no physical listening judgement.

record.reviewMode: Independent read-only implementation and completed-report audit; no checker edits or synthesis rerun. This JSON is the review artifact.

coverageReview.voicePrograms: Correct physical OPL two-operator slot map, nine channels, both FM/additive connections and feedback0..7; main references require nonzero PCM except the explicit cold-key-off scene.
coverageReview.positiveModulation: AM and vibrato flag programs alter actual PCM; EGT sustain programs differ.
coverageReview.opl1Waveforms: Selected waveform writes all produce the same PCM; recorded hashes also match the separately audible unmodified connection0/feedback3 program in both builds. No OPL2 waveform capability is claimed.
coverageReview.timersIrqCsm: A/B positive first-IRQ deadlines4/16 native frames, fixed status0x06 and IRQ mask bits, stop/clear, mask hiding and unmask reveal are tested. Masked Timer A CSM sounds independently on all nine configured physical channels without ordinary key-on or visible IRQ.
coverageReview.rhythmMutes: Each of five isolated drum keys sounds, its physical mute group silences it, and unmuting matches continuously evolving reference PCM; all nine melody groups are checked likewise.
coverageReview.ownedPcmGrowth: A nonzero owned PCM array survives both a same-capacity render and an actual render of current bufferFrames+1; capacity increase is asserted. This is PCM buffer growth, not a claim of WebAssembly heap growth.
coverageReview.resetAndLatch: Data after a pending C0 address and raw reset is compared against an explicit C0 write; connection is intentionally omitted from reprogramming so the latch test cannot be overwritten. Raw reset differs from power-on waveform; public reset recreates power-on output and reapplies JS mute mask.
coverageReview.seek: Real VgmPlayer covers three chip clocks and three output rates, six seek targets each, floor-converted position and257-frame continuation against complete baseline, with checkpoint count/bytes0 and unavailable snapshot assertions.
coverageReview.accounting: Main bodies,257-frame probes and selected public reset/replays are reconstructed from case records. Wrapper output and actual Engine processFrames counts during VGM prefetch/seek are separate components. Delivered/discarded player output and native source frames are not added twice.
coverageReview.stateScope: No raw save/load exports or public state API exist. The checker makes no serialized-state equivalence or checkpoint-restore claim.

limitations: Recorded executions were reviewed; no physical audio device or listening assessment was used.
Checker intentionally excludes optional Sega PSG, Native backend, Worklet scheduling and hardware-emulation conformance claims.
